newsitem.title: USA: Rockwell electronics business 87 pct of EPS.
newsitem.headline: Rockwell electronics business 87 pct of EPS.

text.p: Rockwell International Corp said its electronics business accounted for 71 percent of its total sales and 87 percent of its earnings for the first quarter ended December 31.

The company reported earnings of $179 million, or $0.82 per share, compared with $192 million, or $0.89 per share, for the period. The earnings came on revenue of $2.6 billion compared with $2.4 billion.

Of those amounts, electronics brought in $1.85 billion in revenue, compared with $1.63 billion a year earlier, while the company's automotive operations brought in $755 million, compared with $755 million a year ago.
